title: skills-sh-cazala-webgpu-skill-webgpu
summary: # WebGPU Quick Reference ## Device + context ```ts const adapter = await navigator.gpu?.requestAdapter(); if (!adapter) throw new Error("WebGPU not supported"); const device = await adapter.requestDevice(); const context = canvas.getContext("webgpu"); const format = navigator.gpu.getPreferredCanvasFormat(); context.configure({ device, format, alphaMode: "premultiplied" }); ```
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
